note: Opt-in island variant (open the game with ?island=b): island B, the Blender-refined 144 m block island that was the default in Stage 3. Positions and landmark texts are the Stage 3 ones; quests, unlock rules, NPC ids and dialogue come from world.json and explore.json unchanged (explore.json positions are island B's own).

landmarks.signal-woods: The forest path below the lookout, on the island's northern rise.
landmarks.viking-workshop: The timber workshop east of the village green.
landmarks.trading-market: The harbour market with three stalls and the ledger desk.
landmarks.great-hall: The Jarl's longhouse at the north side of the village.
landmarks.web-frontier: The arrival dock on the south shore.
